channel.title: 1bit.MONSTER — Blog
channel.description: How the 1-bit inference engine actually gets built — NPU, ROCm, kernels, formats.

item.title: Byte-identical: 1,000 tokens of proof against AMD's real runtime
item.description: Milestone: our NPU decode is now bit-for-bit identical to AMD's own runtime — verified across a full 1,000-token generation, zero differences. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/journey.md

item.title: The 35B MoE's NPU packing: 5,120-byte tiles, 4,736-byte rows, and an A/B interleave
item.description: Milestone: we decoded how AMD packs a 35-billion-parameter model for its NPU — verified byte-for-byte against AMD's own code, even though AMD's loader crashes on the same file. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/journey.md

item.title: Zaya 8B Q4NX on the AMD NPU
item.description: Milestone: an 8-billion-parameter model now runs entirely on AMD's laptop NPU — attention and experts on-device, served over HTTP, decode 8.4 tok/s. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/research/ws12-hrx-loom/README.md

item.title: Lemonade v11.8.1, and how we stay current with the SDK
item.description: Milestone: the re-vendor loop in action — Lemonade v11.8.1 synced into the engine days after release, with every checkpoint mapped. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/guides/Lemonade-Compat.md

item.title: HRX: we put AMD's experimental IREE runtime inside our engine
item.description: Milestone: AMD's experimental NPU runtime now runs inside our engine — one process, two runtimes, roughly twice the warm decode, with the honest ceiling measured. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/research/hrx-backend.md

item.title: Lemonade v11.8.0: the 15-backend SDK lands ds4 for Strix Halo
item.description: Milestone: the AMD SDK release built for our chip — the 15th backend (DeepSeek V4 Flash for Strix Halo) embedded, plus download resume and rate limits. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/guides/Lemonade-Compat.md

item.title: One engine, 1,775 models
item.description: Milestone: 100% of Hugging Face's text models now run on one engine — 317,310 checkpoints map to a single binary that auto-detects the architecture, no Python involved. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/research/hf-coverage-audit.md

item.title: Local RAG with our own embeddings
item.description: Milestone: fully local RAG on one binary — embed, index, retrieve and generate on your own hardware, no cloud, no Python. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/CODEBASE.md

item.title: What 1-bit actually does to a model
item.description: Milestone: models packed to ~1.6 bits per weight run on hardware you already own — memory drops ~16x and matmuls become additions. What 1-bit actually does to a model, explained plainly. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/journey.md

item.title: ROCm vs CUDA, from the 1-bit trenches
item.description: Milestone: 1-bit matmuls on AMD silicon measured against CUDA from real kernel work — the comparison behind why every model runs on AMD's stack. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/engine_comparison_report.md

item.title: Lemonade v11.7.0, and how we stay current with the SDK
item.description: Milestone: the SDK sync loop — Lemonade v11.7.0's core embedded so the engine stays current with every AMD release, 14 backends included. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/guides/Lemonade-Compat.md

item.title: Two PCs, two GPUs, zero cloud
item.description: Milestone: a two-computer AI fleet with zero cloud — 35B and 8B models served locally across a LAN, both instances fed entirely by our own engine. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/journey.md

item.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B streams fully on the Ryzen AI NPU
item.description: Milestone: a 35-billion-parameter model streaming on a laptop NPU — AMD's own numbers decoded and independently verified, plus our first Vulkan pass. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/journey.md

item.title: 37 FLM models, 209 xclbins, zero config files
item.description: Milestone: AMD's entire NPU model collection extracted — 37 models and 209 bitstreams, auto-detected from the model files with zero configuration. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/research/fastflowlm-analysis/README.md

item.title: Zyphra family complete
item.description: Milestone: Zyphra's entire model family runs at 1-bit precision on GPU — all four models validated end to end, including a reasoning model at 26 tok/s. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/model-families/zyphra.md

item.title: One binary, all formats
item.description: Milestone: one binary runs every model format — 1-bit, ternary and binary checkpoints on NPU and GPU alike, no rebuilds, no per-model config. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/journey.md

item.title: Unsloth for AMD
item.description: Milestone: training and fine-tuning land on AMD hardware — 2x faster, 70% less memory, fits in 3 GB, alongside our inference engine. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/wiki/unsloth-dynamic-ggufs.md

item.title: TokenRouter: token-level multi-backend inference
item.description: Milestone: token-level routing between NPU and GPU — one chip drafts, another verifies, and real logprobs ride the wire between them. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/journey.md

item.title: What the Ryzen AI Halo reviews didn't tell you
item.description: Milestone: the 50-TOPS laptop NPU driven directly — what the reviewers missed, in our own measurements. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/journey.md

item.title: DSpark speculative decoding, disproven
item.description: Milestone: a speculative-decoding method that promised 572 tok/s delivered ~0.1-0.2 tok/s — disproven with measurements, and what it would take to fix. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/spec-decode/README.md

item.title: Three bugs that broke 97 tok/s
item.description: Milestone: full-speed NPU decode that was secretly garbage, made correct — three silent bugs found and fixed at 97 tok/s. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/journey.md

item.title: One engine. Every model. Any chip.
item.description: Milestone: one binary runs every model on every chip — architecture auto-detected from the file, backend auto-chosen, no per-model builds. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/CODEBASE.md

item.title: 244 to 3.4 ms/tok: the NPU optimization sprint
item.description: Milestone: NPU inference from 1,930 to 3.4 ms per token in four days — a 72x speedup through batch decode, fused dispatch and INT8 kernels. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/engine/npu/BENCHMARKS.md

item.title: 50 TOPS on a laptop
item.description: Milestone: the first month's NPU benchmarks, kept honestly — 50 TOPS on a laptop, early numbers flagged as unsourced history. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/engine/npu/BENCHMARKS.md

item.title: The fused layer engine
item.description: Milestone: a model's layers fused into single NPU calls — six times fewer dispatches per layer, making the laptop NPU a practical inference target. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/npu-infer/docs/fusion-level-0.md

item.title: I reverse-engineered AMD's NPU stack in 4 days
item.description: Milestone: AMD's locked NPU stack replaced with open C++ in four days — a laptop, a disassembler, 22 proprietary libraries, zero documentation. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/research/fastflowlm-analysis/README.md

item.title: 1bit Coding Agent released
item.description: Milestone: a coding agent that runs entirely on your hardware — a CLI with NPU-native inference, package management, extensions and skills, in the monorepo. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/docs/archive/openspec/changes/1bit-pi-clone/proposal.md

item.title: NPU v12: M=32 batch decode at 97 tok/s
item.description: Milestone: NPU batch decode hit 97 tok/s — a 24x speedup in one session (244 to 10 ms/token), 46% faster than AMD's own stack. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/engine/npu/BENCHMARKS.md

item.title: Historical benchmark: both lanes green
item.description: Milestone: an early two-lane local run, kept for the record — one model, iGPU and NPU, both green. Full technical write-up: https://github.com/1bit-MONSTER/1bit-MONSTER/blob/main/engine/npu/BENCHMARKS.md
